messages:
alice: quick question — I opened #4287 which renames a top-level dir and updates CODEOWNERS to point at team aliases. meant to be a small hygiene change but it touches several ownership globs. who can actually approve this?
ben: pinging @carmen since it touches the runtime/ and infra/ globs — is that on the platform owners list?
carmen: I saw the PR, thanks. it's partly infra, partly runtime libs. CODEOWNERS currently has:```/runtime/* @runtime-team /infra/* @infra-team /libs/* @platform-team```I think the rename removes the old `/runtime/` path and adds `/runtime-v2/` which isn't covered. we should avoid landing until the new alias is covered.
sre-lead: can SRE sign off on infra globs if it's a straight rename with no behavior change? happy to if infra-team agrees, but we should confirm there's no deploy config changes.
alice: no deploy config changes in the PR, it's literally a directory rename + imports updates. I added a note in the PR description.
ben: dev-bot FYI labeled the PR `needs-approval:codeowners-change` so it won't auto-merge.
dev-bot: automated message: PR #4287 labeled needs-approval:codeowners-change — blocking merge until an approver listed in CODEOWNERS or a repo admin approves.
carmen: two options: (1) add the new alias `@runtime-team` to CODEOWNERS for `/runtime-v2/*` in this PR and get runtime owner approval, or (2) keep CODEOWNERS unchanged and ask a CODEOWNER from platform or infra to explicitly approve the PR.
alice: prefer (1) so we don't rely on manual cross-team approvals each time we rename. but I don't want to add team aliases without making sure the alias exists.
ben: does org group `runtime-team` exist? our infra for aliasing sometimes uses team slugs like `@redwood/runtime` vs `@runtime-team`.
carmen: current aliases in the repo are `@redwood/runtime`, `@redwood/infra`, `@redwood/platform`. if we add `/runtime-v2/* @redwood/runtime` that's safe.
sre-lead: I'm good to approve infra portion once the CODEOWNERS entry is explicit in the PR. runtime owners need to sign off on the runtime alias change.
alice: updated the PR to include this snippet in CODEOWNERS:```/runtime-v2/* @redwood/runtime```and added a short note: "adding runtime-v2 path to CODEOWNERS to match dir rename — no behavior change".
dev-bot: automated message: PR #4287 updated. Labels unchanged.
ben: tagging @carmen for an explicit review approval when you have a sec. I can approve infra side after Carmen signs off. :thumbsup:
carmen: reviewing now. small nit: please also sync the root README path mentioned in runtime/README.md — one link points to `/runtime/examples` which should be `/runtime-v2/examples`.
alice: fixed the README link and pushed a tiny commit.
carmen: looks good to me. Approving for runtime side.
ben: approved for infra and platform overlap. merging once CI green and no outstanding comments.
sre-lead: leaving a quick note: if we expect more renames, let's add a short PR checklist to the repo CONTRIBUTING.md to include "update CODEOWNERS and confirm alias" so this is less ad-hoc.
alice: agreed — I'll open a tiny PR after this lands. thanks everyone! :rocket:
